content: googlevideo stream URLs are signed, IP-locked, expire after about 6 hours; requests from another IP or after expiry return 403. URL params (itag, mime, clen, signature) must not be modified or reordered. Range requests supported (206 + Content-Range) only while URL valid. Byte offset does not map linearly to playback time (keyframes, VBR, moov atom), so time-interval to byte-range mapping is approximate; MP4 needs moov atom before mid-file decoding.
